problemStatement: The current workflow sends Telegram and commits the local archive before pushing the protected data branch. If the push fails and the runner disappears, the next run reconstructs from origin/data without the delivered receipt and can reacquire and send the same report again. Existing local archive-transaction tests do not cover this external boundary.

riskAssessment.reason: The change governs a boundary after an external Telegram side effect and before a protected data-branch update. A bad recovery path can duplicate a public report or overwrite a conflicting archive. Validation therefore uses isolated refs and a recording transport, with fail-closed identity checks.
riskAssessment.reviewedBy: Codex under explicit continuation authorization and xinglun account selection

reasons: The Work Item changes external-publication recovery and durable data-branch behavior.
The acceptance requires non-secret, identity-bound failure-injection evidence.

executionDecision.reason: The missing boundary is concrete, scoped to the existing Weekly Radar pipeline, and has an isolated verification path that does not require a live fault injection.

preReviewWarnings: Never read back, echo, or store Secret values; the failure-injection transport must be non-live and recording only.
Do not use the live data branch or configured Telegram destination for deliberate failure injection.
The durable pending identity must be validated before any recovery push; mismatches fail closed without overwrite or resend.
A recovery result is not a new human reference; system and human lanes remain independent and non-voting.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A production-shaped isolated run persists the report, snapshot, receipt, and manifest after one successful recording transport call.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The receipt report ID, message IDs, snapshot, report, and manifest are mutually bound before the push boundary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused isolated harness and inspect only non-secret artifact identities and transport invocation count.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The data push is forced to fail after Telegram acceptance, then recovery reuses the original receipt without a second transport call.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The forced failure is retained, the pending identity is durable, recovery publishes the same artifact set, and transport count/message IDs remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use an isolated bare Git remote with a deterministic rejecting hook, a recording transport, and a recovery run against the pending ref.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A damaged or mismatched pending transaction fails closed and preserves conflicting bytes.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Recovery reports an incomplete/conflicting state, performs no Telegram call, and does not overwrite or delete the conflicting artifact.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Corrupt one isolated pending artifact or identity, run recovery, and compare pre/post bytes plus transport count.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The user-facing operations guide explains automatic push, recovery, and the independent system/human reference lanes.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Documentation describes observable behavior and commands, not internal project progress, and does not claim a single cooperative answer.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review the changed guide against the workflow and CLI behavior after tests pass.

checkpointPolicy.reason: The Work Item crosses a public-delivery side effect and a durable branch update; capture the contract boundary before editing and evidence before finish.

acceptance: The workflow has a durable, guarded pending-publication path for a report whose Telegram receipt exists but whose data push did not complete.
Recovery validates the original report, receipt, snapshot, manifest, and pending identity, publishes the same data tree, and never calls Telegram a second time.
An isolated production-shaped failure-injection harness forces the push failure after one recording Telegram acceptance and verifies final data-tree consistency and zero duplicate message IDs.
A damaged or mismatched pending transaction fails closed without overwriting conflicting bytes or sending again.
The user-facing operations guide documents automatic push/recovery and keeps system reference and human reference as independent mutual references rather than one merged answer.
The complete AI Cockpit evidence lifecycle, hosted PR checks, merge, close, and clean-state verification pass without credentials being stored.
guidelines: Do not read or record Secret values; credentials remain only in GitHub Secret storage.
Do not manually mutate the protected data branch or rewrite historical artifacts.
Evidence before claim: bind workflow, report, snapshot, receipt, manifest, pending identity, and final data commit.
Keep machine/system reference and human reference independent; do not merge, vote, or override either view.
Preserve fail-closed UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONFIGURED, and UNDETERMINED states.
User-facing documentation is about operating behavior, not project-progress narration.

intent.problem: A successful Telegram side effect currently precedes the data-branch push, and runner loss after push failure can cause a later run to resend the same report.
constraints: Keep live fault injection and duplicate live delivery out of scope.
Use a durable pending identity plus strict artifact binding, and fail closed on conflict.
Keep the system-generated reference and human reference as separate views that mutually inform a person; neither view is merged into the other.
intent.rationale: A guarded pending publication path makes the external side-effect boundary explicit and gives the next run a verifiable identity to publish without reacquisition or duplicate Telegram delivery.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuation of the production objective; approval is limited to the bounded Weekly Radar workflow recovery change and does not authorize live fault injection or secret readback.

requiredEvidenceContext.externalSystem: Isolated local Git remote and non-live recording transport; production Secret values and live Telegram are excluded.

rollbackNote: If verification fails, preserve the redacted failure evidence, stop before merge, and revert only this Work Item branch after confirming no live data or Telegram side effect was used.
